cases.title: Platform admin signs in through the login form and lands on /admin (Platform Administration, no tenant navigation)
Tenant roster: search narrows to the tenant; status ACTIVE, user / campaign counts match the DB
Search with no match shows "No tenants found for the current search."
Tenant detail: View opens the modal with the tenant name, user count and the team (owner email, SUPER ADMIN)
Suspend from the roster: badge SUSPENDED, Activate offered, DB status SUSPENDED
Suspended tenant: API login -> 403 "Tenant suspended"; the login form shows the error and stays on /login
A user signed in before the suspension is signed out or told the workspace is suspended on the next screen (no broken page)
Reactivate: Activate -> ACTIVE badge, DB ACTIVE, the tenant owner can sign in again
Add Tenant: required fields block an empty submit (no API call); valid form creates tenant + INVITED SUPER_ADMIN + magic link
Add Tenant duplicates: same tenant name -> "A tenant with this name already exists"; same admin email -> "A user with this email already exists"
Stats tiles: Total Tenants / Suspended match /api/admin/stats (read around the page load)
Tenant SUPER_ADMIN cannot reach the console: /admin and /admin/tenants redirect to /app/dashboard; /api/admin/* -> 403
Platform admin is kept out of tenant screens: /app/contacts redirects to /admin; tenant API -> 403
Scheduler card on /admin: current state shown; Pause / Resume ask for confirmation and flip the flag; original state restored
/admin/tenants shows the tenant list (no stats tiles); /admin/users lists tenant users with search
Scheduler switch (API, platform admin): stop -> paused + flag holds the admin email; start -> running; original state restored
Tenant admin / agent cannot pause or run the scheduler (403), flag unchanged; status is readable
Platform admin signs out from the profile popup: /login, and /admin then redirects to /login
